title: Coproduct module sheaves as locally finite-coordinate tuples
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose topology is given by covering families, with fibre products of objects, and let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on it. Assume the sheafification of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules exists [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $I$ be a set in the fixed sheaf universe and $(H_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the sectionwise product $P=\prod_{i\in I}H_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful]. Define a subpresheaf $S\subseteq P$ by
$$S(V)=\{(h_i)_i\in P(V):\ \text{there is a covering }\{V_a\to V\}_a\text{ and finite }B_a\subseteq I\text{ with }h_i|_{V_a}=0\text{ for }i\notin B_a\}.$$
Restrictions and module operations are induced from $P$. Then $S$ is a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules. For each $i$, the coordinate insertion $\iota_i:H_i\to P$ factors through $S$, and these maps make $S$ a coproduct of the $H_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: for every sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules $T$, composition with the $\iota_i$ is a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(S,T)\xrightarrow{\sim}\prod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(H_i,T).$$
Consequently the canonical map $\bigoplus_{i\in I}H_i\to\prod_{i\in I}H_i$ is a monomorphism and its image is exactly this subsheaf $S$.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: Take S to be the chosen coproduct of H_i, and m:S→∏H_i the map whose i-th projection is the coordinate retraction Sigma.π. The local finite-sum normal form [lem-pur-module-sheaf-coproduct-local-generation] says that any section of S is locally the finite sum of its coordinate insertions. If m(x)=m(y), every coordinate of x-y is zero; the normal form makes x-y zero locally. Separatedness makes x=y. Thus every component of m is injective, and m is a monomorphism.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: For h=m(x), choose the covering and finite sets from the same local-generation lemma. Applying the coordinate retraction indexed outside the chosen finite set kills each summand. Naturality identifies this coordinate with the restriction of the corresponding product coordinate of h. This proves the forward image characterization.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: Conversely suppose h has finite support locally. On each witnessing cover member form the finite sum of the coproduct insertions of its product coordinates. Its image under m equals the restricted h: verify every projection, using diagonal/off-diagonal insertion identities and the vanishing outside the support. Evaluation preserves products by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-limits-sectionwise], so agreement of all coordinates is equality.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: The sieve where h lifts through m contains the given covering family, hence is covering. Choose local preimages on that sieve. For any two compatible arrows, naturality says that the images of the two restricted lifts are equal; the sectionwise injectivity of m makes the lifts equal. Glue this compatible family in S. Naturality and the gluing equations show that its image agrees locally with h, and separatedness of the product makes its image h globally. This also handles empty covers.

source.place: Tag 03DB, lemma-limits-colimits and its proof (module-sheaf coproduct is the sheafification of the sectionwise coproduct); explicit image in the sectionwise product.

proof.text: The chosen coproduct and its insertions satisfy the discrete colimit property and the Hom bijection by [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. The diagonal and off-diagonal projection identities follow from the coordinate retractions. Finally Sigma.desc of the insertion composites with m is m by coproduct hom extensionality. It is therefore monic and has the same range in every section.
